text:
Yahoo Sports summed up Egor Chinakhov's month in a headline: "Egor Chinakhov needs to trust the process." Six points in 17 games is a quiet start for a winger with a scorer's tools, and his ice time has slipped to about 14:50 over his last ten games.

The tools are still loud. NHL EDGE puts his top shot speed at 98.9 mph, the hardest-shot percentile at the very top of the league, and his skating speed in the 97th percentile. He's shooting 9.1% against a league norm of 13.4%, and his teammates have scored 3.2 fewer goals than expected with him on the ice, so the point total undersells the work a little.

The worry is volume. His expected goals (the quality of his chances) sit at 0.99 per 60, fine but not a sniper's rate. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking liked how often he reached the home-plate area last season (83rd percentile for forwards). Those trips are the thing to watch. Our talent range has his true scoring rate well above where it sits now.
